description: K-09 (#304) Quarterly Prompt-Panel & Tell Half-Life Benchmark: 40 deterministic prompts (8 verticals × 5 prompt styles) used to measure default-template tell drift and half-life across page generators.

promptStyles.label: Zero-Shot Minimal
promptStyles.description: Single-sentence underspecified prompt ('Build a landing page for X'). Exercises raw generator default priors.

promptStyles.label: Vibe / Trend Prompt
promptStyles.description: Adjective-heavy prompt requesting 'modern, sleek, futuristic, high-converting SaaS aesthetic'.

promptStyles.label: Detailed Product Spec (No CSS Tokens)
promptStyles.description: Concrete product copy, metrics, and section requirements without specifying colors, fonts, or radii.

promptStyles.label: Explicit Negative-Constraint Prompt
promptStyles.description: Prompt with explicit avoid-list prohibiting purple accents, gradient text, Inter/Space Grotesk, pill badges, and 3-card grids.

promptStyles.label: DESIGN.md + Slop-Detect Skill Assisted
promptStyles.description: Prompt paired with a normative DESIGN.md YAML token contract and pre-commit slop-detect verification instructions.

prompts.prompt: Build a landing page for ChronicleOps, a B2B SaaS platform for incident retrospectives and SLA tracking.
Create a sleek, modern, futuristic, high-converting SaaS landing page for ChronicleOps with glowing cards, bento feature grid, and social proof.

Build the marketing page for ChronicleOps. Include: (1) Hero explaining pager-to-postmortem timeline assembly in 90 seconds, (2) comparison table of MTTR across P0/P1 incidents, (3) SOC 2 Type II and SAML 2.0 compliance section, and (4) 3-tier per-seat pricing ($18, $39, $79/user/month).

Build a landing page for ChronicleOps (incident retrospective software). Do NOT use purple accents, gradient text, glowing borders, pill badges above headings, 3-card icon grids, or Inter/Space Grotesk fonts. Use a high-contrast tabular layout with concrete incident timestamps.
Build the ChronicleOps landing page adhering strictly to DESIGN.md (surface #F6F4EE, ink #181815, primary #1F5E3B, IBM Plex Mono, radii 2px/4px) and verify score < 10 with slop-detect.
Build a landing page for anvil-trace, a fast CLI profiler for Rust and Go binaries.
Design a dark-mode next-gen developer tool landing page for anvil-trace with neon gradients, glassmorphism, and floating terminal badges.

Create the homepage for anvil-trace v1.4.0. Show `curl -fsSL https://anvil-trace.dev/install.sh | sh`, a flamegraph dwarf-unwind overhead table (1.2% CPU at 999Hz), Linux perf_event_open kernel requirements (>= 5.15), and MIT license footer.

Build the anvil-trace v1.4.0 CLI homepage. Avoid all default template patterns: no purple/indigo accents, no gradient headings, no radial spotlights, no 3-column Lucide icon cards, and no marketing superlatives.
Build the anvil-trace CLI page using the repo DESIGN.md tokens and run `npx slop-detect` to ensure 0 triggered design or copy patterns.
Build a landing page for LedgerLine, an API for automated treasury and multi-currency reconciliation.
Make an ultra-clean, warm editorial fintech landing page for LedgerLine with serif display typography, cream surfaces, and bento cards.

Build the LedgerLine product page covering FedNow/RTP settlement windows, ISO 20022 `camt.053` ingestion latency (< 450ms per 10k entries), immutable double-entry idempotency keys, and basis-point volume pricing.
Create the LedgerLine treasury API page. Do not use gradients, blurred backdrop cards, unanchored percentages ('10x faster'), pill eyebrow badges, or generic testimonials.
Implement the LedgerLine landing page governed by DESIGN.md and verify AEO + design compliance via slop-detect.
Build a landing page for WardSync, a clinical shift handoff and patient intake platform for hospitals.
Design a modern AI-powered healthcare landing page for WardSync with soft gradients, floating glass cards, and glowing call-to-action buttons.

Build the WardSync clinical operations page. Detail HL7 FHIR R4 `Encounter` bi-directional sync with Epic and Cerner, I-PASS resident sign-out checklist verification, BAA execution workflow, and 99.95% inpatient uptime SLA.
Build the WardSync hospital shift handoff page. Strictly avoid decorative blobs, purple/cyan gradients, stock avatar rings, and vague claims like 'revolutionize patient care'.
Build the WardSync page with explicit DESIGN.md tokens, accessible WCAG AAA contrast, and zero slop-detect pattern triggers.
Build a landing page for Kobo Fieldworks, a brand selling machined aluminum mechanical pencils and field notebooks.
Create a warm editorial luxury storefront for Kobo Fieldworks with cream backgrounds, Instrument Serif headers, and rounded bento product highlights.

Create the Kobo Fieldworks Model 04 Draftsman Pencil page: 6061-T6 bar stock, 9.4mm knurled grip, 24.2g weight balance table, brass Schmidt DSM 2006 0.5mm chuck specification, and spare parts schematic.
Build the Kobo Fieldworks Model 04 specification sheet page. Use an industrial datasheet grid; do not use pill badges, gradient buttons, 3-column feature cards, or marketing buzzwords.
Build the Kobo Fieldworks specification page bound to DESIGN.md tokens and validated with slop-detect.
Build a portfolio website for Studio Meridian, a digital product design and systems engineering studio.
Build an award-winning agency landing page for Studio Meridian with glassmorphism, dark mode spotlight gradients, and kinetic bento case study cards.
Create the Studio Meridian index page listing 14 shipped industrial and embedded UI engagements (2019–2026) with client, year, hardware target, and deliverable archive links.
Create an index-first portfolio for Studio Meridian. No hero banner, no purple accents, no gradient text, no 'We craft digital experiences' copy, and no 3-card service grids.
Build the Studio Meridian archive table adhering to DESIGN.md and passing `slop-detect --fail-on mild`.
Build a landing page for TensorGate, an AI model routing and evaluation gateway.
Design a futuristic AI infrastructure landing page for TensorGate with glowing violet meshes, glassmorphic cards, and 'Supercharge your AI workflow' hero copy.

Build the TensorGate routing documentation and landing page: OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` proxy overhead (0.8ms median), fallback circuit-breaker YAML config, and token cost attribution per org header.
Build the TensorGate inference proxy landing page. Use a light paper surface, monospace latency tables, and zero purple/indigo/violet accents, zero glowing borders, and zero hype adjectives.
Build the TensorGate benchmark and docs landing page using DESIGN.md tokens and verify Clean tier on design, copy, and craft axes.
Build a documentation landing page for libschema-c, a zero-allocation JSON Schema validator in C99.
Make a modern developer documentation homepage for libschema-c with gradient hero text, glowing feature cards, and pill version badges.

Create the libschema-c v0.9.2 reference page: Draft 2020-12 compliance matrix, arena allocator API (`schema_arena_init`), SIMD UTF-8 validation throughput (3.4 GB/s on AVX2), and tarball SHA-256 checksums.
Build the libschema-c v0.9.2 manual page in the style of a POSIX manpage and RFC specification index. No hero marketing banner, no icon cards, no gradients.
Build the libschema-c specification landing page following DESIGN.md and passing all slop-detect design, copy, craft, and AEO checks.
